name: singlet_clustering_cluster_stability
title: Cluster stability under cell resampling
description: Scores how reproducibly each cluster of an existing partition is recovered when cells are resampled and the clustering is repeated, returning per-cluster and per-cell stability and replicate ARI. Requires raw counts and the partition column; it does not test whether a stable cluster is a real cell type and does not choose a resolution. Use dry_run first, because cost scales with n_resamples and the clustering pipeline; the default method is subsample_jaccard.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

cluster_key.description: obs column holding the partition to test, for example a Leiden column at one resolution.

method.description: Scoring rule. subsample_jaccard is the default (per-cluster best-match Jaccard); coclustering_robustness scores within-cluster pair retention.

name.description: Prefix for written members: stability gives obs/stability_score, uns/stability_clusters and uns/stability_replicate_ari.

resampling.description: Resampling law: number of resamples, fraction of cells per resample and replacement.

n_resamples.description: Number of cell resamples B; more gives a finer per-cluster distribution and smaller Monte Carlo error.

subsample_fraction.description: Fraction r of cells per resample; scores are comparable only at a matched fraction.

replace.description: Draw cells with replacement; default is without replacement, as in scclusteval.

pipeline.description: Clustering pipeline re-applied to each resample: layer, resolution, PCs and feature recomputation.

layer.description: Raw-count layer used when features are recomputed per resample.

resolution.description: Graph-clustering resolution applied to each resample.

n_pcs.description: Principal components used for the neighbour graph in each resample.

recompute_features.description: Re-select variable features and recompute PCA per resample; false reuses the full-data embedding and understates variance.

scoring.description: Per-cluster thresholds and the rule that calls a cluster stable.

jaccard_cutoff.description: Cutoff tau: a resample recovers a cluster when its score exceeds tau; 0.6 is the scclusteval default.

stable_summary.description: Stable rule: median or mean score above tau, or the fraction above tau exceeding percent_cutoff.

percent_cutoff.description: Fraction of resamples above tau required by the percent rule.

min_cluster_size.description: Clusters with fewer cells are reported but not scored; 0 scores every cluster.

seed.description: Base seed; each resample is seeded from it, so identical inputs give identical outputs.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/stability_score. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_resamples, n_clusters, n_scored, n_stable, median_replicate_ari, jaccard_cutoff, stable_summary, recompute_features. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
